WITH ranked AS (

    FROM "employment" e
),
median_company AS (
    SELECT
        "Company_ID",
        AVG("Year_working") AS median_year
    FROM ranked

    GROUP BY "Company_ID"
),
person_contrib AS (
    SELECT

    JOIN median_company m ON e."Company_ID" = m."Company_ID"

)

FROM person_contrib
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;
